model.title: Cooperative Watershed Management Program Reauthorization Act of 2026
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Steve Daines (R-MT)

summary.text: The bill would expand the Cooperative Watershed Management Program, which provides grants for water management projects. It would allow Indian tribes to be included among eligible applicants, add drought, wildfire, and other natural disasters as grounds for demonstrating need, and raise the maximum first-phase grant amount. It would let grant recipients continue a first-phase grant for up to two more years based on satisfactory performance, allow funds to cover grant writing, project management, technical assistance, and post-construction monitoring, and require funding opportunities to be offered regularly with applications accepted multiple times a year. It would also make reports to Congress available to the public and authorize $20,000,000 per year for fiscal years 2027 through 2031.
